historical.source: Internet Archive captures of the LMArena text-to-image leaderboard
notes: Each historical frame is a real LMArena text-to-image leaderboard table captured by the Internet Archive, roughly one capture per month.
Wayback coverage stops in early January 2026 because the archive crawler hits Cloudflare challenges after that; daily StoryOps snapshots resume in July 2026, so the intervening months have no frames.
Historical-only models keep their archived identity so past arena standings stay truthful; display names are mapped onto current arena entity IDs where the model is still on the board.
